summary: Narrow lane beside houses 4-6 m away; no room to stop.

best_section.where: Northern end of the lane, nearest Keith Street junction

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 4-6 m away along the whole stretch; overlooked.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the east side; house on the west.
